notes: Prospective public-data paper comparison only; four new independent flat 1000 USDT ledgers.

Within each cost scenario the sole rule difference is removing the closed 4h swing admission policy. All hourly signal, entry validity, breakout-at-fill, direction, stop, exit, funding, risk and liquidity rules are preserved.
Double costs multiply fee and adverse slippage assumptions by two before risk sizing and execution. Funding is shared, unchanged.
A common exchange UTC inception excludes pre-inception hourly decisions and historical funding; completed history is indicator warmup only.
Code, profile, experiment configuration and effective rules are frozen by SHA256 in the manifest. Restarts preserve balances and reject any incompatible change; no reset option exists.
Review thresholds are a first review scale, not proof of future profitability or a paper entry gate. No automatic production switch.
